what: Clicking a same-site link fades the body and header out over 0.4s power2.inOut, then 0.4s later only the body is swapped and enters from the top over 0.5s power2.out — the document is not reloaded, so header, menu and cookie bar stay unbroken (Barba)

options.wait: Wait before swapping the body (seconds), default 0.4 — starts together with the exit, so the handoff is delayed by whichever of the two is longer
options.in: Duration for new body text to come in (s), default 0.5
options.[data-fx-part=fade]: Stays in the wrapper but leaves and enters together with the body (headline etc.)
options.out-ease: Exit curve — GSAP name or 0.165,0.84,0.44,1, default power2.inOut
options.lag: Delay (seconds) from press until the exit starts, default 0 — the original Barba hands off in sync, so it receives the next page (prefetch cache ~65ms) and starts leaving then (Brand .065)
options.in-delay: Delay (sec) before indenting starts after new body is inserted, default 0 — Brand .3
options.out-y: Distance (px, negative for up) it moves while leaving, default 0 — Brand -100
options.out-blur: Amount of blur as it leaves (px), default 0 — brand 16
options.out-move: Push and blur length (seconds), default same as out — Brand 1 (transparent .8)
options.out-move-ease: Push and blur curve, default same as out-ease — 0.51,0.01,0.99,0.57
options.in-y: Distance the new body text rises in from (px), default 0 — Brand 30
options.in-move: Rise duration (sec), default same as in — Brand 1
options.in-move-ease: Rising curve, same as the default in-ease — brand 0.02,0.48,0.51,1.02
options.in-blur: How much (px) the new body text blurs in from, default 0 — brand 4 (in-move length · in-move-ease curve, filter is cleared at the end)
options.in-fade-delay: Delay only the new body’s fade (seconds), default 0 — brand .2 (the slot starts rising right away)
options.loader: (If present) Every time this many seconds pass after leaving, [data-fx-part=loader] is shown with .8s power3.out (from 16px below into place · when new body content comes in it leaves 16px upward and hides) — Site 1
options.[data-fx-part=loader]: Together with the loader — a ring-like waiting indicator in the center (inside the wrapper, outside the body). Hidden at first

note: Barba fetches the next page with fetch and only runs over http — opened via file:// it drops in with the same values and then navigates normally. The document has one Barba, so the wrapper attaches to just one. ScrollTrigger and window listeners attached in the body are removed by the consumer on fx:page-leave and re-attached on fx:page-enter (detail.container·namespace). If you use Lenis, on fx:page-enter call lenis.scrollTo(0, { immediate: true }) is called
